fields.v: Metric: task resolved (FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS pass), plus cost and time per task. The authors state no success criterion (no target resolution rate or cost limit; results are only compared with the No-Context baseline), so every verdict is 'no criterion stated by the authors'. Study 1 (SWE-ContextBench related tasks; 376 implied, the resolved % are multiples of 1/376), resolved % / avg cost USD / avg time s: (1) Claude Code + Claude Sonnet 4.5, baseline (no context): 19.68 / 0.67 / 344.47; (2) Claude Code + Claude Sonnet 4.5, oracle summary: 23.40 / 0.55 / 280.62; (3) Codex + GPT-5.3 Codex, baseline: 22.60 / 0.31 / 349.41; (4) Codex + GPT-5.3 Codex, oracle summary: 23.94 / 0.27 / 362.39; (5) Qwen Code + Qwen3.5-plus, baseline: 16.22 / 0.33 / 523.47; (6) Qwen Code + Qwen3.5-plus, oracle summary: 21.54 / 0.18 / 455.18; (7) Qwen Code + GLM-5, baseline: 18.35 / 0.58 / 800.99; (8) Qwen Code + GLM-5, oracle summary: 19.41 / 0.48 / 629.34; (9) Claude Code + MiniMax 2.7, baseline: 19.68 / 0.65 / 691.28; (10) Claude Code + MiniMax 2.7, oracle summary: 22.07 / 0.46 / 420.92. Study 2 (SWE-ContextBench Lite, 99 related tasks; Claude Sonnet 4.5, agent not stated), resolved % / PASS_TO_PASS task % / time min / cost USD: (11) No-Context (baseline): 26.26 / 88.89 / 6.37 / 0.79; (12) Free Context Learning: 26.26 / 85.86 / 6.78 / 0.98; (13) Oracle Context Learning: 27.27 / 89.90 / 5.95 / 0.77; (14) Free Summary Learning: 22.22 / 86.87 / 6.28 / 0.91; (15) Oracle Summary Learning: 34.34 / 85.86 / 6.66 / 0.85; (16) Mem0: 24.24 / 86.87 / 4.72 / 0.62, ingestion of 300 trajectories about 21 min, 0.24 USD; (17) OpenViking: 29.20 / 88.89 / 4.20 / 0.53, ingestion about 570 min, 18.96 USD; (18) Supermemory: 30.30 / 88.89 / 5.04 / 0.58, ingestion 369.6k tokens, under 1 h; (19) LangMem: no resolution or run cost reported, only retrieval match (73.34% overall) and ingestion (about 58 min, 0.98 USD). For every configuration: quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors

fields.v: Oracle summaries improved resolution for all five agents (+1.1 to +5.3 points) and lowered cost; best GPT-5.3 Codex 23.94%. On Lite: Oracle Summary best resolution (34.34% vs 26.26%, +8.08); Oracle Context lowest time and cost (5.95 min, 0.77 USD); Free Context most expensive (0.98 USD, +27.3% over Oracle Context, about +24% over the baseline) with no gain in resolution; Free Summary below baseline (22.22%); both summary settings cost more than baseline on Lite (0.91, 0.85 vs 0.79 USD); Supermemory best framework (30.30%), OpenViking cheapest and fastest (0.53 USD, 4.20 min). No significance tests despite 'significantly improve' in the abstract
